# A package's imports resolve in two phases: every import a built-in scheme
# serves first, then the rest against the schemes the packages those reached
# declare with gen.scheme. So where the plugin's import is written does not
# decide whether its scheme resolves: above or below the import that uses it,
# in another file of the package, or in a library the package imports.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off

# The plugin is imported below the import that uses its scheme.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out-after after/app.sngl
grep 'hello, after' out-after/index.html

# The plugin is imported by another file of the package, one that sorts after
# the file using it.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out-files files
grep 'hello, files' out-files/index.html

# The plugin is imported by a library the package imports, and the scheme is
# used by the package itself.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out-lib lib/app.sngl
grep 'hello, lib' out-lib/index.html

-- after/app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import g "greet:after"
import "./greet"

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=g.message)
}
-- after/greet/greet.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

gen.scheme(name="greet", @generate(out, importPath) {
    out.write("greet.sngl", "const message = \"hello, " + importPath + "\"\n")
})
-- files/a.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import g "greet:files"

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=g.message)
}
-- files/b.sngl --
import "./greet"
-- files/greet/greet.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

gen.scheme(name="greet", @generate(out, importPath) {
    out.write("greet.sngl", "const message = \"hello, " + importPath + "\"\n")
})
-- lib/app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import g "greet:lib"
import "./shared"

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=g.message)
}
-- lib/shared/shared.sngl --
import "./greet"

// What the library offers besides the scheme it brings.
const unused = 1
-- lib/shared/greet/greet.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

gen.scheme(name="greet", @generate(out, importPath) {
    out.write("greet.sngl", "const message = \"hello, " + importPath + "\"\n")
})
